cover.woman_bio: This short page checks that video links work on your iPad. Nothing here is graded.

content.content: Tap the blue button. The video should open. Watch about 20 seconds, then come back here. If anything goes wrong, just answer the questions honestly.

content.question: What happened when I tapped the button?
choices: A) The video opened and played
B) It opened but would not play
D) It left this app and I could not get back

content.question: My note: in one sentence, what did the video say?
Anything odd (sound off, page blocked, ads, could not return)?
